name: Peacock Chalk Drawing
shortDescription: A guided chalk drawing of a full peacock with sparse, web-like plumage rather than a broad, fully spread tail.
description: Created during a guided chalk-drawing lesson in a Heritage homeschool class, this piece depicts an entire peacock.
Its plumage is sparse, with thin, branching feather shapes that resemble a spiderweb more than the familiar full fan of a peacock’s spread tail.
